Food has moved to Fuel

The food log is now its own app, Fuel. Your log is still on this phone: 118 days, 2,304 entries, 212 saved foods, 3 saved meals (about 412 KB). Nothing is taken away until you remove it yourself.

  1. Get Fuel
    Get Fuel

    In Safari tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. If Safari does not open, tap Copy link and paste it into Safari's address bar: example.github.io/overload/fuel/

  2. Take your food log along

    Copied today · Saved as a file today.

  3. In Fuel, tap Paste from Overload

    If you saved a file, tap Choose a file there instead.

Using cloud sync? Signing in to Fuel with the same email also brings across the food log your account holds. This phone may hold more, so copy it from here as well.

When Fuel shows your food log

You can remove the old food log from Overload. That frees about 398 KB on this phone. A safety copy is kept first, and your saved foods and targets stay.
